extracted_information: The homepage for Atlas AI, an AI-Powered Marketing Automation Platform. It highlights the platform's capabilities for creating marketing campaigns faster and growing businesses using AI. Key sections include a hero area introducing the platform, a live AI dashboard showing performance metrics, a list of powerful features, client testimonials, a gallery of AI automation templates, and calls to action for starting a free trial or contacting sales. The page also includes navigation links, a footer with legal and resource links, and system status information.

pricing.information: Pricing details are not present on the homepage, but there is a navigation link to a dedicated Pricing page.
